name: NAKIVO Backup & Replication
summary: NAKIVO Backup & Replication protects virtual machines, servers, workstations, NAS shares and Microsoft 365 with scheduled jobs, per-schedule recovery point retention and AES-256 encryption. It sells subscriptions per workload and perpetual licenses per server or socket, with prices given through a calculator or quote, and a 15-day trial.

facts.text: NAKIVO defines a recovery point as a backup of a source at a specific point in time, and supports GFS retention and a schedule retention method with a separate keep-for period per schedule.
Job schedules can be weekly, monthly, yearly or periodical, or run after another job, and recovery points can be made immutable for a set number of days.
The VMware backup page lists AES-256 encryption at source, in transit and at rest.
The VMware backup page lists NAS devices, deduplication appliances, Amazon S3, Wasabi, Azure Blob, Backblaze B2 and tape as storage targets.
The pricing page offers a 15-day trial with no credit card, and shows subscription and perpetual license types with minimums such as 5 workloads or 10 Microsoft 365 users.

plans.name: Subscription (all workloads)
plans.notes: Billed annually upfront, minimum 5 workloads per order, Pro Essentials limited to 50 workloads.

plans.name: Perpetual (servers, workstations, virtual)
plans.unit: per server, workstation bundle or CPU socket
plans.notes: One-time license with 1 year of standard support. Servers and workstations are sold in bundles of 5.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows no dollar amounts; figures come from its pricing calculator or a quote request.
